headline: Amazing happens when two people run a platform that runs itself and recovers on cue.
situation: DR site being built: 8 new hosts and a NetApp array fed by SnapMirror; recovery time objective and orchestration not yet defined

designProfile.consumption: VCF 9.1 with VCF Operations as the daily front door; vCenter consumption unchanged for the team; automation evaluated later.
designProfile.physicalSite: Primary data center and a new DR site.
designProfile.availability: Converged management domain: management components and production workloads share the primary cluster; HA and fully automated DRS retained.
designProfile.isolation: NSX deployed with VCF, VLAN-backed at first; no network redesign on day one.
designProfile.recoverability: DR site as a separate workload domain in the same fleet; replication with an orchestration tool to be chosen.
designProfile.expansion: Evacuated hosts rebuilt into VCF wave by wave; the DR workload domain added once the site is online.

designElements.requirement: VMFS on Fibre Channel is a supported management-domain storage type.
designElements.recommendation: Keep the existing array over Fibre Channel; no vSAN needed.

designElements.requirement: Recovery orchestration and a defined recovery time objective.
designElements.recommendation: Choose the orchestration tool in the recovery design; test DR capacity on the new site.

whatWeHeard.customerPosition: "Make our lives easier"; use features already paid for
whatWeHeard.whereItLands: Operations and logs enablement; a runbook the team repeats

problems.addressedBy: the recovery design picks orchestration so DR is executable under pressure

openQuestions.question: Can a current RVTools export be sent before the first design session?
openQuestions.whyNow: The export on record predates the hardware refresh

technicalItems.item: The VCF Installer deploys vCenter, NSX and VCF Operations with the management domain
technicalItems.reference: VCF 9.1 documentation > Overview > VCF Installer Overview

constraints.constraint: DR site online before DR build and testing
constraints.effect: Recovery design now; DR build follows the site

customerAsks: Decisions by November: hosts for the build, DR policy direction, wave ownership

customerOwnedWork.label: Customer migration waves and legacy cluster retirement

milestonesToDate.detail: Environment, DR site and priorities reviewed.

revision: Built from the VCF 9.1 assessment and the scoping questionnaire of 30 Sep 2026.
